I found Frank’s body in electrical. My route was electrical -> medbay -> electrical -> cafeteria -> back to electrical, and that’s when I reported.

I saw Frank alive in medbay around ticks 2 and 3, then I saw him leave medbay toward electrical at tick 4. I also saw Bob around medbay/storage/electrical — at tick 3 I saw Bob enter medbay from storage, and I also saw movement toward electrical. When I got to electrical around tick 6, I saw both Frank and Bob there, and then later Frank was dead in electrical.

So the body is definitely electrical, and Bob was the last person I saw near Frank there. Not hard accusing yet, but Bob needs to explain his route.

I don’t have much, unfortunately. My route was oxygen to upper_engine, and I didn’t see anyone the whole round — no Frank, no Bob, nobody else.

So I can’t confirm or deny Alice’s electrical info. Based on what Alice said, Bob was apparently near Frank in electrical last, so I definitely want to hear Bob’s full route and timing. For now I’m not hard accusing, but Bob needs to account for being there.

I was nowhere near electrical this round. My route was weapons -> security -> navigation. 

The only person I saw was Eve: I saw her leave security toward navigation around tick 4, and then I was with/near her in navigation around ticks 7, 8, and 9. I didn’t see Frank at all, and I didn’t see Bob or Alice.

So I can’t directly confirm the body info, but Alice’s report sounds pretty specific: Frank was alive, went toward electrical, and Bob was seen there with him. I don’t want to hard vote before Bob talks, but Bob definitely needs to explain why he was last seen near Frank in electrical. Eve was away from electrical as far as I saw, so she looks better to me from my POV.

I can confirm Diana’s side from my POV. I started in security and went to navigation, and I was in navigation with Diana from around ticks 7 through 9. I saw Diana enter navigation from security at tick 7, then she stayed around me there. I didn’t see Frank, Bob, Alice, or Charlie at all this round.

So from my perspective, Diana was on the opposite side from electrical late in the round, and I was too. That makes me feel pretty good about Diana for this kill.

The main info we have is Alice placing Frank and Bob together in electrical, with Frank later dead there. I don’t want to lock a vote before Bob speaks, but Bob really needs a clear route and timing. If he can’t explain being in electrical with Frank, he’s the strongest suspect.

Yeah, I was in electrical, I’m not denying that. My route was storage -> medbay -> electrical, then I doubled back through medbay and ended up upper engine.

I saw Alice in medbay around tick 3, then Frank went from medbay into electrical around tick 4. I went electrical too, and Frank was alive there while I was there. Alice also came into electrical from medbay around tick 5, so it wasn’t just me and Frank. Then I saw Alice leave electrical toward cafeteria around tick 6. I left electrical after that toward medbay/upper engine, and Frank was still alive when I left.

So from my POV, Alice saying “Bob was last with Frank” is leaving out that she was also in electrical with us and then she’s the one who supposedly loops back and finds the body. I’m not saying it’s 100% Alice, but this could easily be a self-report or bad timing. I was not sitting on Frank’s body, and I didn’t see the kill happen.

Diana/Eve sound paired away from this, Charlie has no info. The actual sus pool is me and Alice, but Alice’s route is literally electrical, leaves, then back to electrical to report. That’s not clear enough to just vote me on proximity.

Bob is right that from everyone else’s POV this probably looks like a me/Bob pair, but from my POV it’s very straightforward: I did not kill Frank, and the only person I saw with Frank in electrical right before the body was Bob.

To clarify timing: I saw Frank in medbay ticks 2 and 3, Bob came in from storage at tick 3 and also headed toward electrical, Frank left medbay toward electrical at tick 4. Later, at tick 6, I saw both Frank and Bob in electrical. I left, went cafeteria, came back, and Frank was dead in electrical.

Bob saying Frank was alive when he left is exactly what I’d expect him to say, but I can’t verify that. Diana and Eve seem away from this kill together, Charlie has no info, so unless someone has a contradiction, my vote is almost certainly Bob.

I still don’t have any direct info — my whole round was oxygen to upper_engine and I saw nobody, so I can’t vouch for either side.

Based on the discussion, I agree the real pool is Alice or Bob. Diana and Eve seem mutually away from electrical late, and I wasn’t near it. Between Alice and Bob, Bob admits he followed Frank into electrical and was there with him, which lines up with Alice’s report. Alice could be self-reporting, but Bob definitely had the clearest opportunity if Frank died in electrical after Alice left.

So I’m leaning Bob right now, but I’d want us to be clear that this is based on proximity/opportunity, not because I personally saw anything.

My info hasn’t changed: I was weapons -> security -> navigation, and I was with Eve in navigation from ticks 7 through 9. Eve and I can pretty much clear each other from being in electrical late.

So for me this is still Alice vs Bob. The thing that stands out is Bob admits he went into electrical after Frank, and Alice saw Bob and Frank there together before Frank ended up dead. Alice could technically be self-reporting, but Bob had the most direct opportunity.

Also, Bob says he ended up upper engine, but Charlie says he was oxygen -> upper_engine and saw nobody. That might just be timing, but it’s another thing that makes Bob’s route feel less clean to me.

I’m leaning Bob here. Not 100% hard proof, but with one duck and the body in electrical, Bob has the clearest opportunity and the weakest-looking story.

My info is the same: I was security -> navigation, and I saw Diana come into navigation from security at tick 7. We were both in navigation together ticks 7, 8, and 9, so I’m confident Diana and I were not near electrical when Frank died or was reported.

So I agree the real pool is Alice or Bob. Charlie has no direct info, but I do think Diana’s point matters: Bob says he ended up upper engine, while Charlie says he was going oxygen -> upper_engine and saw nobody. That could be timing, but it doesn’t help Bob.

Between Alice and Bob, Bob admits he followed Frank into electrical, and Alice saw Bob with Frank there before Frank ended up dead. Alice could technically be self-reporting, but Bob had the clearest opportunity and his story feels more defensive than clearing.

I’m leaning Bob. Not 100% hard proof, but with one duck, I think Bob is the strongest vote from the info we have.

I need to push back on the “upper engine” point because that’s being treated like a contradiction when it really isn’t. I said I ended up upper engine after leaving electrical through medbay — I didn’t say I was standing next to Charlie the whole time. If Charlie came from oxygen and we missed each other by timing or pathing, that doesn’t clear or condemn either of us.

The core issue is still Alice vs me, and all the pressure on me is coming from Alice’s version. My version is: Frank was alive in electrical when I left. Alice was also in electrical with us, then she leaves toward cafeteria, then she’s the one who comes back and reports. Nobody independently saw me with the body, nobody saw me kill, and Alice had just as much access to that room as I did.

I get why I’m in the pool, but voting me off just because I was near Frank earlier is a bad call when Alice’s route is literally electrical → away → back to electrical report. If we’re choosing between the two of us, I think Alice is the more suspicious one here.
